text:
oliver (platform): FYI — after the RBAC refactor deployed at 07:42 UTC we saw cross-org session tokens not being invalidated when a project is transferred. Audit logs show the token still active.

anna (sec): omg, can you paste the relevant log lines? @mike (infra) @sarah (eng) please triage :eyes:

devops-bot: Deploy finished: 2026-03-20T07:42:12Z on canary (tag: v2.14.3-refactor)

mike (infra): repro steps I ran locally:
1) create project under org A
2) transfer project ownership to org B (`POST /orgs/A/projects/123/transfer`)
3) call `POST /v1/session/validate` with the old session token -> 200 OK (should be 401)

sarah (eng): quick glance: looks like `session.invalidate_on_transfer` flag wasn't wired into the token-service cache eviction path. missing org check in token invalidation logic.

sarah (eng): snippet from token_cache.go that is problematic:
```
if !opts.SkipInvalidate {
  // missing org ownership verification here
  cache.Delete(sessionKey)
}
```

oliver (platform): potential blast radius: canary cluster shows ~12 active tenants affected, two customers already reported. Need mitigation plan and quick rollback path.

anna (sec): questions: does this bug allow KMS-wrapped keys or stored artifacts to be accessed cross-org? i.e., any Decrypt operations that shouldn't have happened?

mike (infra): preliminary answer: we don't see unauthorized KMS Decrypt events in the short window, KMS CMKs are tenant-scoped. This appears to be limited to session token validation not being revoked. still recommend we run KMS audit queries for the timeframe.

sarah (eng): proposed hotfix: add explicit org id check before eviction + immediate cache eviction for transferred projects. I'll open a PR and add unit + integration tests.

sarah (eng): PR WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/token-service/pull/489

oliver (platform): mitigation ops (suggested):
- enable feature flag `rbac.invalidate_on_transfer=true` for canary
- run `scripts/evict_transferred_tokens.sh --since=2026-03-20T07:40Z` on canary
- advise support to rotate any customer API keys if requested

tara (oncall): I'll spin up an incident page and notify affected customers. drafting comms now.

anna (sec): also: run a KMS audit query for `Decrypt` events for the two org IDs between 07:40-08:00 UTC and alert if any unexpected principals appear.

mike (infra): hotfix CI is green on canary branch. merging to release branch and rolling to canary (5%).

devops-bot: Rollout started: v2.14.3-hotfix -> canary (5%)

mike (infra): kicked off `evict_transferred_tokens.sh --since=2026-03-20T07:40Z` against canary token-store.

sarah (eng): fixed the missing org-id check and added tests. Verified locally that token invalidation triggers no KMS operations (token path does not call KMS).

oliver (platform): :thumbsup: keep me posted. after ~30m canary, if clean we promote and run global eviction.

tara (oncall): customer comms sent to two affected orgs, incident page: https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-0319-27 (draft v1)

mike (infra): canary healthy after 30m, no regression alerts. promoting to stable.

devops-bot: Rollout complete: v2.14.3-hotfix -> stable

mike (infra): patch merged and released. starting rotation of service account keys for the two affected orgs as extra precaution.

anna (sec): confirming KMS audit: no unexpected `Decrypt` events tied to transferred-project principals in the window. marking KMS risk as low for this incident. filing follow-up for an automated KMS audit alert. ticket SEC-1023.

sarah (eng): PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/token-service/pull/489 (merged). added CI test that simulates project transfer + token validation.

oliver (platform): big thanks. followups: add a gating test in RBAC refactor CI for cross-org transfer flow, and add a metric/alert for token invalidation misses.

tara (oncall): I'll close the incident once key rotations finish and support confirmations come in.

mike (infra): key rotations complete. confirming with sec.

anna (sec): confirmed rotations and audit checks. closing incident. :white_check_mark:
